receiver_primary_definition: Primary FDR<0.05 plus same effect direction in every LODO fit and >=10-cell donor sensitivity analysis
high_confidence_core_definition: Primary receiver robustness plus FDR<0.05 in >=10-cell donor sensitivity analysis
interpretation: LODO assesses donor influence on the T2D-associated beta-cell transcriptional program. It does not establish causality or DRG-to-islet signaling.
